parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649942. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join compound_structures on activities.molregno, and join molecule_dictionary on molregno to obtain chembl_id. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
